summary: Game Your Game Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to a promissory note issued to Grafiti LLC, its parent, and a related securities purchase agreement. The amendment extends the note's maturity to July 31, 2027, and adds repayment provisions tied to a future direct listing and preferred stock issuance. It also modifies security holder rights and notes a director departure. This is routine debt modification and governance disclosure, not a special-situation event.
